title: Knots compose like cycles exactly in difference laws whose distinctions do not split
subject: Circuit elimination of K1-K3 knots across constraint laws: Mal'tsev, group, field and Boolean laws
conclusion: A law with a Mal'tsev polymorphism composes its knots like cycles, so that any two sharing a distinction leave a constraint once it is forgotten and form matroid circuits, exactly when every subalgebra of its polymorphism algebra has a unique maximal congruence; Boolean laws do exactly when affine. Elsewhere knots fuse or meet at hubs, so cycle-space structure among knots marks difference laws whose distinctions do not split.
